statements.t: As a result, we expect to continue to take steps to enhance our existing offerings and offer new services to continue to satisfy the evolving needs of our customers.

We expect our business to primarily grow organically and inorganically through the use of capital for re-investment in the business and opportunistic acquisitions that expedite our product roadmap in the interoperability space should they arise.

The Company currently expects to use the proceeds from the 2026 DDTL Facility for the exclusive purpose of retiring the 2028 Senior Notes on or about October 15, 2027, when they become redeemable at 100% of their principal amount plus accrued interest.

risks.t: among other items: the Company’s ability to grow fax revenues, profitability and cash flows
the Company’s ability to identify, close and successfully transition acquisitions
variability of the Company’s revenue based on changing conditions in particular industries and the economy generally
protection of the Company’s proprietary technology or infringement by the Company of intellectual property of others
general economic and political conditions, including political tensions and war (such as the ongoing conflict in Ukraine and the Middle East)
the impact of new or additional tariffs or other trade restrictions, and the impacts of a U.S. federal government shutdown
